rules_tr: M17 G9 (Claude, 2026-11-15): son eklenen 5 kahramanın ana hikâyede ilk görünmeleri; yerleri yoldaş hikâyelerinin (E9) açılma noktasından önce ve geçtikleri yerde. Satırlar oyunun sahne dosyalarında (games/uomd/content/patches/rel_0003_part1_campaign/story); burası onay kaydı. Kanon: Fadyme'nin sırrı açılmaz, Garrick şansölyenin adını söylemez, Dorian mührün sahibini adlandırmaz.

placements.thistle_roe: vn_4_3_post (eski projeden kalan açık: yoldaş hikâyesi 4-3'te açılıyordu, ana hikâyede ilk 6-3'te görünüyordu)

lines.speaker: rowan_reed
lines.text: Keeper, the alder marker by the shelter lost another letter last night. I will recut it before the light goes.

lines.speaker: shrine_keeper
lines.text: My apprentice, Rowan. He keeps the names this forest keeps forgetting.

lines.speaker: rowan_reed
lines.text: Tell me yours, and I will remember it. That is the whole job.

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.text: Mahmut. Carve it shallow. I do not stay anywhere long.

lines.speaker: rowan_reed
lines.text: Everyone says that. I carve them deep anyway.

lines.speaker: cassian_thorne
lines.text: No rope and no tongue. It rings anyway. Do not stand beneath it.

lines.speaker: sister_aveline
lines.text: Cassian Thorne, the tower's warden. He stayed with the flooded doors when the chapter left them.

lines.speaker: cassian_thorne
lines.text: Eleven carried out since dusk. Count with me. We stop when the numbers match.

lines.speaker: cassian_thorne
lines.text: Twelve. Thirteen. Keep walking; I am still counting.

lines.speaker: garrick_cinder
lines.text: Then they come through the firebreak at the second bell. They always time it to the bell.

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.text: And you are?

lines.speaker: garrick_cinder
lines.text: Garrick Cinder. Night watch, since the watch had no one else. Stand where I put you and nobody burns tonight.

lines.speaker: garrick_cinder
lines.text: Second bell, as I said. Next time they will come early. I will be earlier.

lines.speaker: corbin_locke
lines.text: Seventeen drips a minute on these stairs. If it reaches twenty, the arch is failing and we leave.

lines.speaker: odelia_pike
lines.text: Corbin Locke. He ran the sluices before the Guild bricked the lowest cistern.

lines.speaker: corbin_locke
lines.text: The water has not agreed to the bricks yet. Neither have I.

lines.speaker: corbin_locke
lines.text: Twenty-two at the bricked arch. Not tonight, then.

lines.speaker: dorian_kesk
lines.text: Hunting is a strong word. I filed them. Under 'returned, unopened.'

lines.speaker: kera_voss
lines.text: And who are you supposed to be?

lines.speaker: dorian_kesk
lines.text: Dorian Kesk. I make papers that open doors. You will want some for the gate above, and I will want a favor below.

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.text: We do not buy lies.

lines.speaker: dorian_kesk
lines.text: Then borrow one. The seal on those collars is the only true thing I own, and that is not for sale either.

lines.speaker: thistle_roe
lines.text: Y-you are waiting too. I am Thistle. I tend the bell garden at the monastery, when there is a monastery to tend.

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.text: Mahmut. Who are you waiting for?

lines.speaker: thistle_roe
lines.text: Clem. She reads the graves; I bring the flowers. It is easier to wait with someone.
